name: Perfectionism
items_note: Items copied from https://ipip.ori.org/newHEXACO_PI_key.htm, 10 November 2026, +keyed items first as the key page lists them.

source.paper: Ashton, M. C., Lee, K., & Goldberg, L. R. (2007). The IPIP-HEXACO scales: An alternative, public-domain measure of the personality constructs in the HEXACO model. Personality and Individual Differences, 42(8), 1515-1526

licence.text: Public domain (IPIP). Permission is granted automatically for any person to use IPIP items for any purpose, commercial or non-commercial.

instructions: Describe yourself as you generally are now, not as you wish to be in the future. Describe yourself as you honestly see yourself, in relation to other people you know of the same sex as you are, and roughly your same age.

items.text: Want every detail taken care of.
Want everything to add up perfectly.
Pay too little attention to details.
Prefer to just let things happen.

reliabilitySource: Coefficient alpha of the IPIP scale from the IPIP comparison table for the IPIP-HEXACO scales, https://ipip.ori.org/newHEXACO_PI_table.htm, accessed 10 November 2026. The table gives no sample size. The bracketed alpha beside the facet on the scoring key page belongs to the corresponding HEXACO-PI scale, not to these items.
